note: `includeData` as a string — it is a boolean.
Unknown member — the community holds one logo, so there is nothing to select.
Response with no `logo` — a community that holds none answers `logo: null`, so a caller can tell no logo from a malformed answer.
Padded or standard base64 in `data` — it is base64url without padding.
A logo `url` that is not `https` — the logo is drawn on pages served over https, and a plain-http address would be blocked as mixed content.
